- **Consumer value:** Steve decides on evidence; Dana finds terms and a name she can trust are the official toolchain's.
- **Observes:** one page; each section gives findings, the command and HEAD hash, and a Recommendation line; an Owner items list, each open with the date asked.

- **Criterion 1 (NEW-STATE, MULTI):** ids `package-licences` (every PackageReference id+version in tracked `*.csproj` and the generated-project template: licence, nuspec source, shipped / generated / test-only) and `vendor-terms` (every model in `bench/results/*.json`: vendor, what is published, terms status). Pre-change: page absent.
- **Criterion 2 (MULTI):** `secrets-scan` (NEW-STATE: command, range root..HEAD, patterns, count, a disposition per finding, never a value), `author-metadata` (NEW-STATE: distinct author/committer identities counted against `git log`, described without names or addresses), `personal-names` (CHARACTERISATION: `scripts/check-no-personal-names.py` exits 0; if it fails pre-change it becomes NEW-STATE). Pre-change: sections absent (the `personal-names` id passes today).
- **Criterion 3 (NEW-STATE, MULTI):** `name-collisions` (each registry and domain with date and source, headed "not a professional search"), `owner-items` (public name; holder line at NOTICE:2 and TRADEMARKS.md:5; professional trademark search; the four lawyer questions; author identity going forward; unread vendor terms). Pre-change: sections absent.

- **Named test (all criteria):** `Pre_publication_findings_match_the_repo` in `tests/Avowry.Acceptance.Tests/PrePublicationChecks.cs` with `[Trait("Slice", "186")]`, `[Trait("Criterion", "186-1")]`, `[Trait("Status", "Pending")]`: one Pending test with one id per row (`package-licences`, `vendor-terms`, `secrets-scan`, `author-metadata`, `personal-names` (a characterisation), `name-collisions`, `owner-items`), each id a check of the committed page against the repo (D222: the red record lists every row of the Ready draft with its ids first). Fails by assertion on the pre-change tree (the page is missing, every id blocked). Not-in-this-card also: a professional trademark search, reading vendor terms online, rewriting history or the git identity.

Scenario: [Z] zero findings still recorded
  Given the history scan finds nothing
  Then the page shows 0, the command and the HEAD hash

Scenario: [O,S] one generated-project dependency
  Given FastEndpoints 8.3.0 in the template
  Then one row: MIT, generated project, not in the Avowry package

Scenario: [M] many references, one row each
  Given three test packages in three projects
  Then each id+version appears once and none is missing

Scenario: [B] tracked files only
  Given untracked Phrase-named copies under .mob/
  Then only `git ls-files` paths count

Scenario: [I] one-word owner ask
  Given an owner item
  Then it is open with its ask date, and NOTICE and TRADEMARKS.md still hold the marked placeholder

Scenario: [E] the mob cannot verify
  Given terms or a trademark search need the web
  Then the row says "not reviewed: needs <source>" and recommends holding the publish

Scenario: [E] a live secret is found
  Then the page names file and commit, not the value; stop the line; rotation goes to the owner

- **Not in this card:** filling the holder; editing NOTICE, TRADEMARKS.md, LICENSE; the professional search; reading terms online; rewriting history or git identity; CLI package metadata (finding for the publish card); publishing.
